Getting here

Travel & Stay

🚶
On Foot

City Chambers sits on the Royal Mile. Edinburgh Waverley station is a 10-minute walk.

🚌
By Bus / Tram

Lothian Buses stop on the Royal Mile. The tram runs from Edinburgh Airport to York Place — 10 min walk from the venue.

🚕
Taxi

City Taxis Edinburgh: 0131 228 1211. Please book ahead for the evening — it gets busy in the Old Town on weekends.

🏨
Where to Stay

We recomend Premier Inn Edinburgh City Centre (Royal Mile) hotel (5 Min from City chambers) Or KM hotel (15 Minute walk from City Chambers) .
